# one call per line: the tool, then each word as a Go string.
# pair: two verbs give -n to flags of different names. Before the verb,
# -n cannot be read, since it is --name to one and --number to the other.
pair "hello" "-n" "ada"
pair "count" "-n" "5"
pair "-n" "ada" "hello"
pair "-n" "5" "count"
pair "-n" "5" "hello"
pair "-nada" "hello"
pair "-n=ada" "hello"
pair "-qn" "hello"
pair "-u" "5" "hello"
pair "-u" "5" "count"
pair "--number" "5" "hello"
pair "--number" "5" "count"
pair "--number=5" "count"
pair "--name" "ada" "hello"
pair "--name" "ada" "count"
pair "-e" "-n" "ada"
pair "-c" "-n" "5"
# clash: a verb's flag that is another verb's short flag is refused when
# the tool is checked, so no call runs.
clash "-d" "look"
clash "look" "-d"
clash "delete"
